info.title: Team Recruitment Automation Tool
info.description: Helps hackathon organizers shortlist the top teams from registration data using configurable eligibility rules and weighted scoring.

post.description:
Accept a registration file, validate it, and return structured results.

Supports optional explicit column/field mapping. Unmapped fields are
preserved in ``custom_fields`` and ``raw_data`` without causing errors.
If valid, persistently stores the dataset snapshot and returns dataset_id.

List all uploaded datasets ordered by upload timestamp.

post.description:
Execute signal extraction for teams and their members.

Only runs the analyzers and signals explicitly requested in ``selected_signals``.
Preserves all member and team associations without combining results into
composite scores. Automatically persists the run into the extraction run store.

Flatten an ExtractionRunResponse into a list of member-signals dictionaries.

Produces:
    [{"member_id": ..., "signals": [...]}]
Enables API clients to pipe signal extraction outputs directly into
/api/rules/evaluate and /api/scoring/evaluate without custom scripts.

schema.title: Response Flatten Signals Api Signals Flatten Post

post.description:
Upload a registration file and run signal extraction in a single request.

Parses CSV/JSON using the dynamic ingestion engine, maps columns, and runs
only the selected signals across all parsed teams and members.

Extract signals directly from an uploaded PDF or DOCX resume document.

Enforces file size limits (10 MB) and format validation (PDF, DOCX).
Returns standardized ExtractionRunResponse with extracted signals.

get.description: Retrieve a recorded signal extraction run with all team and member results.

put.description:
Update a rule configuration.

Guarantees immutability by creating a new version with an incremented version number.
Previous versions are preserved unchanged.

delete.description: Soft-delete a configuration by marking it inactive.

schema.title: Response Delete Configuration Api Rules Configs  Config Id  Delete

get.description: List all available version numbers for a given configuration.

post.description:
Execute deterministic eligibility evaluation against teams and signals.

- Resolves configuration by config_id (default: 'basic' preset) and optional version.
- Evaluates all active rules in deterministic order.
- Generates human-readable explanations per rule and overall team decision.
- Persists the run record into the run store.

get.description: Retrieve an evaluation run's results, with any manual overrides merged.

post.description:
Apply an organizer's manual eligibility override to a team in an evaluation run.

Requires a non-empty explanation reason. The original evaluation record remains immutable.

get.description:
